title: Product Attributes
description: Define product options such as size, color, and material.

help.title: About Product Attributes
help.overview: Attributes are shared option lists such as Size or Colour. A variant picks one value from each attribute that defines it, so the attribute is what turns one product into several SKUs.

sections.title: Fields
items: Name is required. Values are the choices buyers see, for example S, M, L; up to 50.
Visible on product page shows the attribute in the product's details. It does not change prices.
Used for variants marks it as an attribute that splits products into SKUs.
Position orders attributes on the product page and in the variant picker.

sections.title: How variants use it
items: Each variant stores attribute-and-value pairs. Two live variants of the same product cannot have the same combination.
The cart and the till charge the variant price, or the product price when the variant has none.
An attribute used by any live variant cannot be deleted. Remove it from those variants first.
Deleting is a soft delete and it can be restored.
